title: Sketchpad Design Scene From Elements
description: Replace the 3D scene in semio/sketchpad design app with the scene from elements (@elements/scene via TopologyScenePane). Wire representations, selection, hover, drag-drop, and relocate; remove dead legacy SemioScene path.
summary: Replaced sketchpad design app 3D scene with @elements/scene via TopologyScenePane. Design topology adapter builds valid elements.scene.fixture/v1 (domain, attractions, kit mesh URLs, selection/hover flags). DesignTopologySceneWindow adds relocate toolbar, scene chrome defaults, and library drag-drop onto the ground plane. Removed ~900 lines of legacy SemioScene/RepresentationDesign path.
